hero.subtitle: Travel from Lisbon to the heart of the Alentejo with a private door-to-door chauffeur service. Enjoy a premium Mercedes and personalise your journey with a winery, cultural or gastronomic stop along the way.

intro.title: From Lisbon to the Heart of the Alentejo
intro.p1: Leave Lisbon behind and travel privately through the Portuguese countryside to Évora, one of the country's most historic and distinctive destinations.
intro.p2: With Off We Go Portugal, your professional chauffeur collects you directly from your hotel, private residence, Lisbon Airport or another agreed location and takes you comfortably to Évora or from Évora back to Lisbon.
intro.p3: Your premium Mercedes is reserved exclusively for you and your party, providing a comfortable door-to-door journey with the flexibility to travel according to your own itinerary.
intro.p4: Whether Évora is your final destination or part of a wider journey through Portugal, your transfer can be tailored around your travel plans.
intro.imageAlt: Private Mercedes chauffeur transfer Lisbon Évora

directions.title: Lisbon to Évora or Évora to Lisbon
directions.body: Pickup and drop-off can be arranged at hotels, country estates, private residences, Lisbon Airport or another agreed location.

experiences.title: Make the Journey Part of Your Alentejo Experience
experiences.p1: Your private transfer doesn't have to be simply transportation from Lisbon to Évora.
experiences.p2: With advance planning, additional experiences can be incorporated into your journey, allowing you to discover more of the Alentejo before reaching your final destination.
experiences.note: Optional experiences and stops are tailored according to your interests and available time. Additional waiting, sightseeing, admissions and experiences are quoted separately and may require advance reservations.

winery.name: Alentejo Winery Experience
winery.description: Discover the region's winemaking traditions with a visit and tasting at a carefully selected Alentejo winery. Winery experiences can be incorporated by prior arrangement and are subject to availability.
winery.imageAlt: Alentejo Winery Experience private transfer Lisbon Évora

arraiolos.name: Arraiolos
arraiolos.description: Discover a traditional Alentejo town known for its historic castle, whitewashed streets and centuries-old tradition of hand-embroidered Arraiolos rugs.
arraiolos.imageAlt: Arraiolos historic town and castle stopover Lisbon Évora transfer

corkCountryside.name: Cork & Alentejo Countryside
corkCountryside.description: Experience the landscapes that define the region, from cork-oak forests and vineyards to rolling plains and traditional rural scenery.
corkCountryside.imageAlt: Cork-oak forests and rolling Alentejo countryside scenery

montemor.name: Montemor-o-Novo
montemor.description: Add a cultural stop in this historic Alentejo town, dominated by the impressive ruins of its medieval castle and panoramic countryside views.
montemor.imageAlt: Montemor-o-Novo medieval castle and countryside views

explore.title: Arrive in Évora Ready to Explore
explore.p1: Évora's UNESCO-listed historic centre brings together more than two thousand years of history, from its Roman heritage to medieval streets, churches and traditional Alentejo architecture.
explore.p2: Whether you're staying overnight in the city, continuing to a countryside property or visiting Évora as part of a wider Portuguese itinerary, we can coordinate your transportation around your plans.

vehicles.title: Travel in a Premium Mercedes
vehicles.note: Tell us the number of passengers and luggage when requesting your transfer and we'll recommend the most suitable vehicle.

eClass.imageAlt: Mercedes-Benz E-Class private transfer Lisbon Évora

airport.title: From Lisbon Airport Directly to Évora
airport.p1: If Évora is your first destination in Portugal, we can collect you directly from Lisbon Airport and continue to the Alentejo without the need to travel into Lisbon first.
airport.p2: Airport pickup includes flight monitoring, Meet & Greet in the arrivals area with a name sign and up to 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time after flight arrival.

items.question: How long does the private transfer from Lisbon to Évora take?
items.answer: A direct journey generally takes approximately 1 hour 30 minutes, depending on traffic and the exact pickup and drop-off locations.

items.question: Can I book Évora to Lisbon?
items.answer: Yes. The service is available in both directions.

items.question: Can we visit a winery during the journey?
items.answer: Yes. A winery visit or tasting can be incorporated by prior arrangement, subject to availability and reservation confirmation.

items.question: Can you collect us directly from Lisbon Airport?
items.answer: Yes. We can meet you at Lisbon Airport and take you directly to Évora or another agreed destination in the region.

items.question: Can you collect us from an Alentejo hotel or countryside estate?
items.answer: Yes. Pickup can be arranged from hotels, estates, private residences and other agreed locations.

items.question: Can we make additional stops?
items.answer: Yes. Additional stops can be incorporated according to your itinerary, with additional time and costs quoted separately.

items.question: Can you provide child seats?
items.answer: Yes. Please provide the child's age in advance so the appropriate seat can be arranged.

items.question: Which Mercedes should we choose?
items.answer: The appropriate vehicle depends on the number of passengers, luggage and preferred level of comfort. Our team will recommend the most suitable option.
